# AD FutureStack

> AD FutureStack is a technology consulting and software engineering studio specializing in scalable cloud architectures, custom web & mobile applications, AI workflow automation, and enterprise multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

AD FutureStack partners with ambitious startups and enterprises to design, build, and deploy production-grade software solutions with high uptime, zero-trust security, and modern UX design.

## Core Services

- [Custom Product Engineering](https://adfuturestack.dev/services#product-engineering): High-performance React and Next.js interfaces built for speed, accessibility, and modern user interaction.
- [APIs & Microservices](https://adfuturestack.dev/services#backend-apis): High-throughput Node.js, Spring Boot, and Go microservices with sub-50ms latency.
- [Mobile App Development](https://adfuturestack.dev/services#mobile-engineering): Native iOS and Android cross-platform React Native mobile applications.
- [AI & Workflow Automation](https://adfuturestack.dev/services#ai-automation): Custom LLM integrations, RAG vector search pipelines, and autonomous AI workflow orchestration.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps](https://adfuturestack.dev/services#infrastructure): Multi-region AWS and GCP cloud architectures with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.
- [Multi-Tenant SaaS Systems](https://adfuturestack.dev/services#saas-architecture): Pre-engineered SaaS foundations with tenant data isolation, role-based security, and subscription billing.

## Solution Blueprints

- [Enterprise Multi-Tenant SaaS Blueprint](https://adfuturestack.dev/solutions#saas-blueprint): Multi-tenant architecture foundation featuring database isolation and Stripe billing.
- [AI Workflow Automation Suite](https://adfuturestack.dev/solutions#ai-automation-blueprint): Autonomous AI agents connecting LLMs to enterprise ERP/CRM systems.
- [High-Throughput API Gateway](https://adfuturestack.dev/solutions#api-gateway-blueprint): Sub-20ms low latency API routing, Kafka streaming, and Prometheus telemetry.
- [FinTech Payment & Compliance Platform](https://adfuturestack.dev/solutions#fintech-blueprint): Double-entry ledger, PCI-DSS compliance, fraud scoring, and KYC/AML workflows.

## Technical Capabilities

- [Distributed Systems](https://adfuturestack.dev/capabilities#microservices): gRPC, REST APIs, Kafka streaming, Redis caching, zero-downtime rolling deploys.
- [Cloud & Infrastructure](https://adfuturestack.dev/capabilities#cloud): Infrastructure-as-code automation, Docker, Kubernetes, multi-region failover.
- [Data Architecture](https://adfuturestack.dev/capabilities#data): PostgreSQL, ClickHouse analytics, real-time ETL pipelines, data encryption.
- [Zero-Trust Cybersecurity](https://adfuturestack.dev/capabilities#security): OAuth2, SAML SSO, SOC2 & ISO 27001 compliance readiness auditing.
